absx.body_src:
split x at 0
-x, x < 0
x, x >= 0

sq2.body_src:
split r = x^2 at 1
r, r < 1
1/r, r >= 1

stp.body_src:
split x at a, b
0, x < a
1, a <= x <= b
2, x > b

1.src:
scene(1):
    space: 2D(t, y)
    show: wave
    hide: H7
    clip: y > -0.5
    view: -2*\pi <= t <= 2*\pi and -2 <= y <= 2
    step:
        show: +H7
        set: a = 2
        note: "{wave} 아래 $\int$ {{넓이}}"
    step:
        animate: a = 1 -> 3, 0.5s, loop
        view: -1 <= t <= 1
        note: + "{wave(1) > 0}"

H2.src: highlight(; between(lin, quad) and 0 <= x <= 2; green)

H6.src: highlight(; y < par(x) and not (x > a))
